popoto_long_range_3row.level_convention: source_level_db + sensitivity_db + gain_db is the PEAK voltage at the ADC (the simulator's convention); an rms source level adds 3 dB to every overload figure
popoto_long_range_3row.recovery_sets_are: ILLUSTRATIVE: no board has been measured
popoto_long_range_3row.recovery_note: recovery_after_pulse_s counts from the nominal end of the direct pulse at each hydrophone (pulse + distance / c); closed_form_recovery_s counts from the last clipped sample, which the pulse's edge taper (window_alpha) puts before the nominal end, the earlier the less a hydrophone is overloaded
